id.description: The active ability's ID. Must be a namespaced string.

display_name.description: The display name of the active ability.

activation_inputs.description: The inputs required to activate the active ability.

activation_type.description: The type of activation this ability emits.
activation_type.$comment: 'raycast' is... a raycast and will require 'raycast_data'; 'aura' is a spherical emanation and will require 'radius' (or... i guess just 'range' since it represents the same idea); 'self' will only affect the user; and 'nearest' will require 'count', which represents targeting the x nearest valid entities with the ability.

cooldown.description: The amount of time it takes for the ability to come off cooldown.
